title: Hackers Exploit Critical Cisco Expressway Flaw, Breach Four Devices and Reach Internal Network
content_md: Threat actors have been observed exploiting a recently disclosed critical security flaw in Cisco Expressway to breach a Russian organization shortly after the public release of a proof-of-concept (PoC) exploit. The activity involves the exploitation of CVE-2026-76466 (CVSS score: 9.8), a vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker with network access to a Cisco Expressway

CVE-2026-76466.evidence: The report says threat actors exploited CVE-2026-76466 shortly after a public PoC, breached four Cisco Expressway devices and reached the internal network of a Russian organization.
